title: ComputeAssetIdentity
description: Identifies a single compute asset (host + GPU(s) + runtime context) at a point in time. v0.1.

asset_id.description: Stable, operator-assigned identifier for this asset across receipts. Recommended ULID or UUID v4.

hostname.description: Operator-resolvable hostname. May be a tailnet name, internal DNS name, or short hostname.

manufacturer.description: GPU or asset OEM (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD, Intel).

gpu_count.description: Count of GPUs visible to the host runtime at observation time. 0 is permitted for cpu_only_node.

vram_total_mib.description: Total VRAM in mebibytes across all GPUs as reported by the runtime.

driver_version.description: Driver version as reported by nvidia-smi or equivalent.

cuda_reported_version.description: CUDA version reported by the driver (e.g., '13.1'). Distinct from any toolkit version.

runtime_exposure.description: Which runtimes can see the GPU(s).

gpu_uuid.description: Per-doc treatment rules. May be 'redacted', a sha256 hex string (when treatment=salted_hash), or the literal UUID (when treatment=full).

board_serial.description: Board serial subject to the same treatment rules as gpu_uuid.

host_mac.description: Host network MAC. Same treatment rules. Optional.

privacy_treatment.description: Required disclosure of how the identifiers are represented in this artifact.

salt_id.description: Identifier for the salt used when privacy_treatment=salted_hash. The actual salt is stored locally only.

name.description: Operator identifier (human, agent, or CI worker name).

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over the receipt JSON. Empty string permitted in v0.1; required in v0.2+.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the identity observation.

evidence_sources.description: Raw command output files (or other artifact paths) that this identity record was derived from. Each entry references an artifact in receipts/evidence/ with a sha256.

tool.description: Tool name that produced the artifact (e.g., 'nvidia-smi', 'docker info', 'systemctl status vastai').

command.description: Exact command line used to produce the artifact (operator-supplied, for replay verification).

artifact_path.description: Operator-resolvable path to the raw output artifact.
